title: An uploaded doodle passes the picture age check; the words decide
description: Fabio 2026-10-17, after MPI-1171: a doodle given as an input picture (not drawn on Scribble's blank canvas) is still refused, since a stick figure 'could be under 18'. When the age question says YES, the describer is asked SKETCH_QUESTION (only a rough doodle on a plain background, no face/hands/body detail, no photo under strokes); a bare YES saves the age verdict as NO, so the typed words decide. Benched 16 pictures x3 on the ComfyUI Qwen3-VL 4B describer: 5 doodles YES 15/15, children (photo, painted, line art traced from a photo, a photo with strokes over it) and adults NO 33/33.
